# Overview

Step by step from the models in `5_entrytags.Rmd`, one change at a time, on six questions first:

| model | formula | compared with |
|---|---|---|
| M0 (reference) | `time + (1 | world_region)` | |
| M1-priority (reference) | `time + (1 | tradition) + (1 | world_region)` | |
| R | `time + (1 + time | world_region)` | M0: do regions differ in their trends? |
| T | `time + (1 | mm(tags)) + (1 | world_region)` | M1-priority: the tagging tree instead of our six coded traditions |
| RT | `time + (1 | mm(tags)) + (1 + time | world_region)` | R and T: do tags and regional trends overlap? |

**Data** as in `5_entrytags.Rmd` (so differences come from the models, not the data): groups only, child
questions as answered (conditional), conflicting answers weighted 1/n, time = (`year_from` - 1000) / 1000
(**0 = 1000 CE**). The reference fits (M0, M1-priority) and their LOO results are read from `fits/`.

Questions: murder other religions, gossiping, performance of rituals, conversion non-religionists,
is unquestionably good, possesses hunger.

**Tags** (see `preprocessing/inspect_entrytags.py`): religious tags only (the "Religious Group" tree, not
language), each entry's own tags. Tags with the same name are treated as one tag (the tree has 59 names with
several tag ids, e.g. Protestantism three times). Tags carried by at least 10 group entries are kept (69 tags);
an entry gets the **average** of its tags' effects (multiple membership, weights 1/*k* for *k* tags, as for our
coded traditions). Group entries with none of these tags (57) share one level, "untagged". Not hierarchical: a
sub-tag is a level of its own (experts usually tag an entry with both the parent and the sub-tag, so such
entries get half of each). Caveats: some kept tags are synonyms of each other (Christian Traditions,
Christianity, Christian) and some are descriptors rather than traditions (regions, periods, types).

**Priors** as before: intercept normal(0, 1.5), slope normal(0, 1), SDs exponential(1); lkj(2) for the
intercept-slope correlation of the region slopes (R, RT).

**What we look for**

1. The average time slope (`b_time`) across M0, R, M1-priority, T and RT.
2. Region slopes (R): SD, each region's slope, region curves.
3. Tags (T): SD compared with the tradition SD of M1-priority; the largest tag effects; whether the main
   tradition tags agree with our coded traditions.
4. RT: does the region slope SD shrink when tags are in the model?
5. LOO: R vs. M0, T vs. M1-priority, T vs. M0, RT vs. R and vs. T.

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py` and `5_entrytags.Rmd` (reference fits). Fits are saved in
`fits/` as `buildup_<model>_<question>.rds` (delete them to refit), figures in `fig/buildup/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/buildup/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/buildup"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

questions <- c(
  "murder other religions", "gossiping", "performance of rituals",
  "conversion non-religionists", "is unquestionably good", "possesses hunger"
)
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
d <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  mutate(time = (year_from - 1000) / 1000)

# groups only, child questions as answered (as in 5_entrytags.Rmd)
d_groups <- d |> filter(poll == "group")
d_model <- d_groups |> filter(question_short %in% questions, !inferred)

d_model |> group_by(question_short) |> summarise(entries = n_distinct(entry_id), rows = n())
```

## Tags

```{r tags, message = FALSE}
entity_tags <- read_csv("../data/sccsrv3/entity_tags.csv")
group_entries <- d_groups |> distinct(entry_id)

# each group entry's own religious tags; tags with the same name are one tag
own <- entity_tags |>
  filter(str_starts(entrytag_path, fixed("Religious Group[")), entrytag_name != "Religious Group") |>
  semi_join(group_entries, by = "entry_id") |>
  distinct(entry_id, tag = entrytag_name)

# tags carried by at least 10 group entries
n_min <- 10
common <- own |> count(tag, name = "entries") |> filter(entries >= n_min) |> arrange(desc(entries))

# per entry: its common tags (weights 1/k), or "untagged"
entry_tags <- group_entries |>
  left_join(own |> semi_join(common, by = "tag"), by = "entry_id") |>
  mutate(tag = coalesce(tag, "untagged")) |>
  group_by(entry_id) |>
  mutate(k = n(), slot = row_number(), w = 1 / k) |>
  ungroup()
K <- max(entry_tags$slot)

# wide: tag1..tagK, tw1..twK (tw: model_data.csv already has w1..w3 for the coded traditions);
# empty slots get the entry's first tag with weight 0
tags_wide <- entry_tags |>
  select(entry_id, slot, tag, tw = w) |>
  complete(entry_id, slot = 1:K) |>
  arrange(entry_id, slot) |>
  group_by(entry_id) |>
  mutate(tag = coalesce(tag, first(tag)), tw = coalesce(tw, 0)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = slot, values_from = c(tag, tw), names_sep = "")

d_model <- d_model |> left_join(tags_wide, by = "entry_id")
stopifnot(!anyNA(d_model$tag1))

cat(nrow(common), "tags with >=", n_min, "group entries;",
    sum(entry_tags$tag != "untagged" & entry_tags$slot == 1), "of", nrow(group_entries), "group entries have one,",
    sum(entry_tags$tag == "untagged"), "untagged; up to", K, "tags per entry\n")
entry_tags |> filter(slot == 1, tag != "untagged") |> count(tags_per_entry = k)
common |> print(n = 20)
```

# Models

```{r models}
mm_term <- paste0(
  "mm(", paste0("tag", 1:K, collapse = ", "),
  ", weights = cbind(", paste0("tw", 1:K, collapse = ", "), "), scale = FALSE)"
)
mm_group <- paste0("mm", paste0("tag", 1:K, collapse = ""))  # name of the tag term in ranef() / coef()

formulas <- list(
  r = bf(answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 + time | world_region)),
  t = bf(as.formula(paste("answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 |", mm_term, ") + (1 | world_region)"))),
  rt = bf(as.formula(paste("answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 |", mm_term, ") + (1 + time | world_region)")))
)

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
)
priors_cor <- c(priors, prior(lkj(2), class = "cor"))
model_priors <- list(r = priors_cor, t = priors, rt = priors_cor)

model_labels <- c(m0 = "M0", m1_priority = "M1-priority", r = "R (region slopes)", t = "T (tags)", rt = "RT (both)")
model_colors <- c(m0 = "#898781", m1_priority = "#eda100", r = "#2a78d6", t = "#1baf7a", rt = "#e87ba4")
```

# Fit

Each model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each question with `update()`. The reference
models are read from the fits of `5_entrytags.Rmd`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
templates <- imap(formulas, function(formula, model) {
  suppressWarnings(brm(formula, data = d_model, family = bernoulli(), prior = model_priors[[model]],
                       chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))
})

fit_question <- function(model, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/buildup_%s_%s.rds", model, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    templates[[model]],
    newdata = filter(d_model, question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 2026, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

read_reference <- function(model, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/entrytags_%s_%s.rds", model, question)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("missing reference fit (run 5_entrytags.Rmd): ", path)
  readRDS(path)
}

fits <- bind_rows(
  crossing(model = c("m0", "m1_priority"), question = questions) |>
    mutate(fit = map2(model, question, read_reference)),
  crossing(model = names(formulas), question = questions) |>
    mutate(fit = map2(model, question, fit_question))
) |>
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = names(model_labels)))
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  filter(model %in% names(formulas)) |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_|^sd_|^cor_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(diag)

diagnostics
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Average time slope

Change in log-odds per 1,000 years (95% interval). M0 and R: across regions; M1-priority: within traditions;
T and RT: within tags.

```{r estimates}
estimates <- fits |>
  mutate(est = map(fit, function(fit) {
    as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_|^sd_|^cor_", regex = TRUE) |>
      summarise_draws(mean, ~ quantile(.x, c(0.025, 0.975))) |>
      rename(lower = `2.5%`, upper = `97.5%`)
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(questions)))

coef_plot <- function(est, xlab) {
  ggplot(est, aes(mean, question, colour = model)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), size = 0.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors, labels = model_labels) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

```{r slopes, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}
p_slopes <- estimates |> filter(variable == "b_time") |> coef_plot("Time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)")
save_plot(p_slopes, "slopes", 8, 5)
```

# Spread: regions and tags

SDs of the region intercepts and slopes, of the tradition intercepts (M1-priority) and of the tag intercepts
(T, RT). If the region slope SD shrinks from R to RT, regional trends are partly differences between tags.

```{r sds, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5}
p_sds <- estimates |>
  filter(str_starts(variable, "sd_")) |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    str_detect(variable, "world_region__time") ~ "region (slope)",
    str_detect(variable, "world_region") ~ "region (intercept)",
    TRUE ~ "tradition / tags (intercept)"
  )) |>
  coef_plot("SD (log-odds)") +
  facet_wrap(~ term, nrow = 1)
save_plot(p_sds, "sds", 12, 5)
```

Correlation between region intercepts and slopes (R, RT):

```{r cor}
estimates |> filter(str_starts(variable, "cor_")) |> select(model, question, mean, lower, upper)
```

# Regions (R)

## Slopes per region

Region slope (average slope + region deviation; mean and 95% interval), with the number of entries per region
and question.

```{r region_slopes, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
region_n <- d_model |> group_by(question = question_short, region = world_region) |> summarise(n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop")

region_slopes <- fits |>
  filter(model %in% c("r", "rt")) |>
  mutate(co = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- coef(fit)$world_region[, , "time"]
    tibble(region = rownames(s), estimate = s[, "Estimate"], lower = s[, "Q2.5"], upper = s[, "Q97.5"])
  })) |>
  select(model, question, co) |>
  unnest(co) |>
  left_join(region_n, by = c("question", "region"))

p_region_slopes <- ggplot(region_slopes, aes(estimate, region, colour = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = filter(region_slopes, model == "r"), aes(x = Inf, label = n), hjust = 1.2, size = 2.5, colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = questions), ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors, labels = model_labels) +
  labs(x = "Time slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_region_slopes, "region_slopes", 10, 6)
```

## Curves per region

P(yes) over time per region (R; mean), drawn within the time range of that region's entries for that question;
black dashed: the population-level curve.

```{r region_curves, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 7}
region_curves <- fits |>
  filter(model == "r") |>
  mutate(curve = map2(fit, question, function(fit, question) {
    dq <- filter(d_model, question_short == question)
    per_region <- map_dfr(unique(dq$world_region), function(reg) {
      years <- dq |> filter(world_region == reg) |> pull(year_from)
      if (length(years) < 2) return(NULL)
      newdata <- tibble(year = seq(min(years), max(years), length.out = 50), time = (year - 1000) / 1000,
                        world_region = reg, weight = 1)
      p <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = newdata, ndraws = 1000)
      newdata |> mutate(mean = colMeans(p))
    })
    newdata <- tibble(year = seq(min(dq$year_from), max(dq$year_from), length.out = 100), time = (year - 1000) / 1000, weight = 1)
    p <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA, ndraws = 1000)
    bind_rows(per_region, newdata |> mutate(world_region = "overall", mean = colMeans(p)))
  })) |>
  select(question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve)

p_region_curves <- ggplot(region_curves, aes(year, mean, colour = world_region, linetype = world_region == "overall")) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = questions), ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(setNames(scales::hue_pal()(10), sort(unique(d_model$world_region))), overall = "black")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "solid", "TRUE" = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), xlim = c(-2000, 2025)) +
  labs(x = "Year (year_from)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
save_plot(p_region_curves, "region_curves", 12, 7)
```

# Tags (T)

## Largest tag effects

Tag intercepts (T; log-odds relative to the average tag; mean and 95% interval): the 8 highest and 8 lowest
per question, with the number of entries carrying the tag for that question.

```{r tag_effects, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12}
tag_n <- entry_tags |>
  inner_join(d_model |> distinct(question = question_short, entry_id), by = "entry_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  count(question, tag, name = "n")

tag_effects <- fits |>
  filter(model == "t") |>
  mutate(re = map(fit, function(fit) {
    r <- ranef(fit)[[mm_group]][, , "Intercept"]
    tibble(tag = rownames(r), estimate = r[, "Estimate"], lower = r[, "Q2.5"], upper = r[, "Q97.5"])
  })) |>
  select(question, re) |>
  unnest(re) |>
  left_join(tag_n, by = c("question", "tag"))

p_tag_effects <- tag_effects |>
  group_by(question) |>
  filter(rank(-estimate) <= 8 | rank(estimate) <= 8) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # order tags by estimate within each question (label made unique per question, suffix removed for display)
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s (%s)___%s", tag, n, question), label = fct_reorder(label, estimate)) |>
  ggplot(aes(estimate, label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), size = 0.2) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = questions), ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Tag intercept (log-odds)", y = NULL)
save_plot(p_tag_effects, "tag_effects", 12, 12)
```

## Tags vs. our coded traditions

Main tradition tags (T) against our coded traditions (M1-priority), one point per question; line: equal. Both
are relative to the average group of their own model, so only roughly comparable.

```{r tags_vs_traditions, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
tradition_tag <- c(
  christian = "Christian Traditions", islamic = "Islamic Traditions", buddhist = "Buddhist Traditions",
  hindu = "Hinduism", chinese = "Chinese Religion", jewish = "Jewish Traditions"
)
coded <- fits |>
  filter(model == "m1_priority") |>
  mutate(re = map(fit, function(fit) {
    r <- ranef(fit)$tradition[, , "Intercept"]
    tibble(tradition = rownames(r), coded = r[, "Estimate"])
  })) |>
  select(question, re) |>
  unnest(re) |>
  mutate(tag = tradition_tag[tradition]) |>
  filter(!is.na(tag))

p_tags_vs_traditions <- coded |>
  inner_join(tag_effects |> select(question, tag, estimate), by = c("question", "tag")) |>
  ggplot(aes(estimate, coded, colour = tradition)) +
  geom_abline(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Tag intercept, T (log-odds)", y = "Tradition intercept, M1-priority (log-odds)", colour = NULL)
save_plot(p_tags_vs_traditions, "tags_vs_traditions", 6, 5)
```

# Model comparison (LOO)

Difference in expected log predictive density (elpd; positive = first model predicts better; 95% interval as
±1.96 SE). Reference LOO results are read from `fits/entrytags_loo_*`.

```{r loo}
loo_question <- function(model, question, fit) {
  path <- if (model %in% c("m0", "m1_priority")) {
    sprintf("fits/entrytags_loo_%s_%s.rds", model, question)
  } else {
    sprintf("fits/buildup_loo_%s_%s.rds", model, question)
  }
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  l <- loo(fit)
  saveRDS(l, path)
  l
}
loos <- fits |> mutate(loo = pmap(list(as.character(model), question, fit), loo_question))

# Pareto k > 0.7 (unreliable LOO estimate) per model
loos |>
  mutate(high_k = map_int(loo, ~ sum(.x$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7))) |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(fits_with_high_k = sum(high_k > 0), observations_high_k = sum(high_k))

elpd_diff <- function(a, b) {
  diff <- a$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"] - b$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
  tibble(mean = sum(diff), se = sqrt(length(diff)) * sd(diff))
}
loo_of <- function(model, question) loos$loo[[which(loos$model == model & loos$question == question)]]

comparisons <- tribble(
  ~first, ~second, ~comparison,
  "r", "m0", "R vs. M0 (region slopes)",
  "t", "m1_priority", "T vs. M1-priority (tags vs. coded traditions)",
  "t", "m0", "T vs. M0 (tags)",
  "rt", "r", "RT vs. R (tags, given region slopes)",
  "rt", "t", "RT vs. T (region slopes, given tags)"
)
loo_diffs <- crossing(comparisons, question = questions) |>
  mutate(diff = pmap(list(first, second, question), ~ elpd_diff(loo_of(..1, ..3), loo_of(..2, ..3)))) |>
  unnest(diff) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(questions)), comparison = factor(comparison, levels = comparisons$comparison))
```

```{r loo_plot, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 4}
p_loo <- ggplot(loo_diffs, aes(mean, question)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = mean - 1.96 * se, xmax = mean + 1.96 * se), size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison, nrow = 1, labeller = label_wrap_gen(25)) +
  labs(x = "elpd difference", y = NULL)
save_plot(p_loo, "loo", 14, 4)
```
